createPost.description: Publish a LinkedIn post as the logged-in member or as a company page they administer: open the composer in a background tab, type the body with one Input.insertText, optionally attach images (company pages), assert actor / media / paragraph count, click Post, then find the new post on the admin list or the member's activity page and return its permalink. Closes every tab it opens.

actor.description: "self" for the member's own profile, or a company admin page URL containing the numeric company id, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/12345678/admin/page-posts/published/.

text.description: Post body. Newlines become paragraphs (one line = one paragraph).

media.description: Absolute png/jpg paths to attach. Company pages only; a self post with media is refused (not proven).

actorName.description: Expected actor name shown in the composer, e.g. "Dwarves Foundation". Default for a company: the composer must not show the member's own name. Default for self: the composer must show the member's own name.

returns.description: {posted: true, url} on success (url is https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:<id>/, or null when the post is live but not located in the list); {posted: false, reason} when a pre-post check fails or the Post click did not take. Nothing is published when posted is false with a pre-post reason.
